skills.name: Common Denominator
skills.definition: Finding a common denominator to rewrite fractions with unlike denominators before subtracting.

skills.name: Numerator Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators (and whole-number parts) once the fractions share a common denominator.

skills.name: Borrowing in Mixed Subtraction
skills.definition: Regrouping one whole unit into the fraction part when subtracting two mixed numbers whose minuend fraction is smaller than the subtrahend fraction.

skills.name: Improper Fraction Conversion
skills.definition: Converting an improper fraction within a mixed number into a whole number plus a proper fraction before subtracting.

skills.name: Whole-to-Mixed Conversion
skills.definition: Rewriting a whole number as an equivalent mixed number by borrowing one unit as a fraction to enable subtraction of a fraction or mixed number.
